content: Developer sales CRM/product suites (ArchiNord, Faham, Xpedeon, Sell.Do, SafeSale, BRIQ, RAG ERP) converge on a near-identical module set: omnichannel lead capture + dedupe; visual Kanban pipeline (typically 8 stages) with auto-assignment and stage ageing; rule-based or ML lead scoring; SLA alarm/escalation when a lead is not contacted within a window (24h or 5 min); unit-level inventory with tower/floor/unit hierarchy, live availability, blocking/holds, reservation with double-booking prevention, price/discount and cost-sheet generation; payment-schedule/installment generation and collection ageing; site-visit/appointment scheduling; source and channel ROI (cost per qualified lead, cost per booking); team/agent performance and conversion velocity; document templates (quotation, reservation form, CTS/SPA drafts); commission tracking for brokers; consent/compliance features (KVKK/VERBIS in Turkey, PDPL in Saudi). Differentiators vendors push: AI lead scoring, voice AI qualification, dynamic pricing, offline-first field app, digital sales rooms, predictive close forecasts. Notably absent from most: granular RBAC with append-only audit, and a real consent ledger.
